theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds: Separating Fact from Fiction
body: Myth: Only rich investors can invest. Truth: Start with any amount. Myth: High risk always means high returns. Truth: Risk and returns are separate concepts.
caption: Common myths often prevent investors from exploring mutual funds. Understanding the facts helps you make informed decisions based on your goals and comfort level. Invest wisely, invest responsibly. #MutualFundMyths #InvestmentFacts #DebunkingMyths #InvestSmartly #FinancialLiteracy
